subject.title: docs: note LanceDB dreaming v0.2.3 via memory-lancedb-dreaming plugin

question: Should OpenClaw core docs add a generic LanceDB/vector-native Dreaming caveat, or should package/version availability for `memory-lancedb-dreaming` stay entirely on ClawHub?
rationale: VISION.md and docs policy discourage plugin promotion in core docs, but current docs also lag the slot-owned Dreaming config behavior and the open linked PR proposes a generic clarification rather than a package endorsement.

options.title: Approve generic docs caveat
options.body: Allow the linked PR or equivalent wording to document slot-owned Dreaming config and point LanceDB-vector-native implementations to ClawHub without naming a package/version.

options.title: Keep availability on ClawHub only
options.body: Close or decline the linked docs PR and keep the package/version announcement in ClawHub and the plugin's own repository/docs.

recommendation.title: Approve generic docs caveat
recommendation.body: Allow the linked PR or equivalent wording to document slot-owned Dreaming config and point LanceDB-vector-native implementations to ClawHub without naming a package/version.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the Dreaming docs surface that vincentkoc recently rewrote, with runtime input available from the memory-slot owners if needed.
